title: QuestionSet
description: Input to `python -m ats.answer`. The gold block is optional so an eval-time question set (no answers supplied) validates and parses identically to our dev question sets.

description.description: Optional provenance note, e.g. flagging a set built against synthetic fixtures rather than real ExtraSensory subjects.

gold.description: Optional ground truth for dev/scoring use. Absent at genuine evaluation time. Additional properties are permitted; the named ones below are what ats/eval/metrics.py consumes.

question_type.description: Grouping key for the PRD Figure 1 breakdown (accuracy by question type).

answer_kind.description: Selects the correctness rule: exact match, tolerance, IoU, or rubric-backed categorical (PRD 7.3).

numeric_value.description: Machine-readable value for numeric answers (seconds for durations, an integer count otherwise), so scoring never parses prose.
